reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed is that the 200 mg is two capsules in each sachet, so it is 100 mg per capsule, and then that there are no reviews and no NSF or USP seal. I stay with Pure Encapsulations or Thorne, and a lab QR code from a brand I have never heard of does not replace a seal I recognize.
objection: New brand, zero reviews, no NSF or USP seal. A QR link to a report the company itself shows me is not the same as a third party certifying the bottle, and $29.99 for 30 days is more than I pay for my usual brand.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, plus a few hundred real reviews, or a lower price for a first box.
